name: Verrak, Warped Sengir
oracle_text:
Flying, deathtouch, lifelink
Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if life was paid to activate it, you may pay that much life again. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if life was paid to activate it, you may pay that much life again. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

needs.what: a value readable from an ability_activated trigger giving the amount of life paid as part of the triggering ability's activation cost (pay_life, pay_life_x, or any life payment), usable both as an intervening-if condition (> 0) and as the amount of a `may` with `pay: {pay_life: <that value>}` before copy_ability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The ability_activated trigger with mana_ability: false and copy_ability (with new_targets) cover the trigger and the copy, and trigger_keys has sacrificed_to_activate for a sacrifice cost, but no trigger key, condition or value_keys entry records the life paid to activate the triggering ability; life_lost_this_turn counts all life loss this turn, not this activation's payment
